title: Free-coordinate sum and ANF coefficient
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the binary cube of dimension $n$ to $\\mathbb F_2$, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate set. Sum, in $\\mathbb F_2$, the values of $f$ over all binary inputs whose coordinates outside $S$ are zero and whose coordinates in $S$ vary freely. This sum equals the algebraic normal form coefficient of $f$ indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: An $\\mathbb F_2$-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$
A subset $S$ of the coordinate set
